title: System
description: System status board data rendered by the system-status widget, listing each data source with its current health state and display styling classes.

lines.description: Ordered list of status rows, one per data source.

key.description: Human-readable label for the data source.

value.description: Current status string, e.g. 'PENDING', 'OK', or a formatted metric.

dotClass.description: CSS class applied to the status indicator dot (controls color).

valClass.description: CSS class applied to the value text (controls color).
